title: Meeting highlights from the Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC) 23-26 October 2023: GLP-1 receptor agonists, available evidence not supporting link with thyroid cancer
authors: European Medicines Agency, Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee
result: PRAC concluded that available evidence does not support a causal association between exenatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, semaglutide or lixisenatide and thyroid cancer, and that no product information update is warranted. The signal assessment began after publication of Bezin et al. (Diabetes Care 2022); the committee reviewed that study, Alves 2012, Hu 2022 and Bea 2023, and cumulative non-clinical, clinical and post-marketing data submitted by the marketing authorisation holders, who are to keep monitoring and report new evidence in periodic safety update reports.
